#+TITLE: Quote and verse blocks

* Quote blocks

#+begin_quote
Plain text in a quote, *bold*, /italic/, =verbatim= and ~code~.

#+end_quote

#+BEGIN_QUOTE
Upper case delimiters.

After an empty line.
#+END_QUOTE

  #+end_quote

#+begin_quote
- a list item
- [ ] a checkbox
- term :: description
#+end_quote

#+begin_quote
| a | table |
|---+-------|
| 1 | 2     |
#+end_quote

in a drawer

* Verse blocks

#+begin_verse
  Great clouds overhead
  Tiny black birds *rise* and fall
  Snow covers Emacs
#+end_verse

#+BEGIN_VERSE
With an [[https://x.org][link]] and =code=.
#+END_VERSE

- in a list:
  #+begin_verse
  a verse in an item
  #+end_verse
